design_philosophy: Premium, visually stunning luxury farmhouse lifestyle. Immersive editorial style balancing nature (Konkan backwaters) with elite architectural precision. Cinematic imagery, generous spacing, and fluid motion.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 headings. Ensure tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers.

body.usage: Use for body text, buttons, forms, and functional UI.

primary.name: Forest Green
primary.usage: Brand anchor. Use for footer backgrounds, primary buttons, strong text contrast on light backgrounds.

secondary.name: Champagne Gold
secondary.usage: Luxury accent. Use for subtle borders, highlight text, active states, and decorative SVG lines.

backgrounds.usage: Primary page backgrounds. Use Ivory for warm sections (About, Lifestyle) and Pure White for crisp gallery/plot displays.

rules: NO cheap gradients. Avoid mixing green and gold in a flat gradient.
Never use pure black #000000; use the dark text color #0F1A15.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large text.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Glassmorphism (The Crystal Variant)' for the sticky header (e.g., backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-black/5). No fully transparent headers if content scrolls beneath.
visual_enhancers.borders: Delicate 1px borders in Champagne Gold (#D4AF37/30) or soft gray (black/5) to separate cards without heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows (e.g., shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(26,54,38,0.08)]) on hover for cards. Default state should rely on borders or very subtle lift.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero image overlay must not exceed bg-black/40. If more contrast is needed for text, use a soft gradient from black/60 to transparent.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use 2-3x more spacing. Apply py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Apply gap-8 to gap-16 in grids.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the gallery and master plan sections, use asymmetrical bento grids (e.g., col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero images, mixed with col-span-4 supporting images).
grids_and_layouts.cards: Farmhouse design cards should have generous internal padding (p-8), image on top (max-h-64 object-cover), and text content below left-aligned.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align body paragraphs and dense text. Center-align hero text only if it balances the architectural imagery.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Use `framer-motion` for line-by-line masked text reveals in the Hero section and staggered fade-ups for grid items.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images inside cards should scale slightly on hover (scale-105) with a smooth transition (duration-500 ease-out).
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Primary CTA buttons (WhatsApp Enquiry) should have an elegant background fill sweep or subtle lift (-translate-y-1) on hover.

components_strategy.html_tailwind: Use custom HTML/Tailwind for all main layout structures, Hero sections, and Bento grids.
components_strategy.shadcn: Use Shadcn components (customized to remove generic styling) for forms, inputs, and the gallery lightbox (Dialog). Override border radii to 0px or 4px for a sharper, premium look.
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky header with glassmorphism. Visible navigation links on desktop, hamburger menu ONLY for mobile.
components_strategy.whatsapp_integration: A floating WhatsApp button fixed to the bottom-right on all pages. Form submissions should format a WhatsApp message string and open it in a new tab using `window.open`.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid="enquire-whatsapp-button").

media.rules: All images must be visually immersive and contextually relevant. No placeholder text images.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 5-page React application using react-router-dom (.js/.jsx files ONLY).
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
Create Framer Motion variants for staggered reveals and line-by-line text masks.
Implement an Enquiry Form that parses inputs into a WhatsApp URL and opens it in a new tab (e.g., https://wa.me/...).
Develop a fully responsive Gallery with categorized tabs and a lightbox (prev/next capabilities) using Shadcn Dialog/Carousel components.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for elegant line icons (Leaf, Map, Phone, Building).
Do NOT use transparent navigation backgrounds. Always use a blur effect or solid color for readability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (or similar js extension).
